name: QSC_PROD_GRP_DENORM
description: This table stores denormalized product group relationships storing the path details from a parent or root node to a descendant node.

columns.name: PROD_GRP_DENORM_ID
columns.description: Product Group Denorm Identifier.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: FIRST_PROD_GRP_ID
columns.description: Product Group Identifier for the first node in the path.

columns.name: LAST_PROD_GRP_ID
columns.description: Product Group Identifier for the last node in the path.

columns.name: SECOND_LAST_PROD_GRP_ID
columns.description: Product Group Identifier for the penultimate node in the path.

columns.name: DENORM_DISTANCE_NUM
columns.description: Distance/Level from the first product group to the last product group in the path.

columns.name: PATH_ID
columns.description: Persistent identifier for the path

columns.name: CONCAT_PATH
columns.description: Concatenation of the node identifiers participating in the path.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Accumulated effective start date of the path.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Accumulated effective end date of the path.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Accumulated active flag on any node in the path.

columns.name: REL_ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Active Flag of the product group relationship.

columns.name: REL_START_DATE
columns.description: Start Date of the product group relationship.

columns.name: REL_END_DATE
columns.description: End Date of the product group relationship.

columns.name: DEFAULT_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate path marked as a default path.

columns.name: UI_COLLAPSE_FLAG
columns.description: Accumulated Collapse Flag for a node on the path.

columns.name: CONCAT_DISPLAY_ORDER_PATH
columns.description: Concatenated Display Order Sequence for node identifiers in the path. By default this column is only populated for UI collapsed path.

columns.name: RUNTIME_STATUS_NUM
columns.description: Column for internal use. Used to store runtime status codes.

columns.name: ADMIN_STATUS_NUM
columns.description: Column for internal use. Used to store admin status.

columns.name: BATCH_KEY
columns.description: Column for internal use. Used to store transient information about the batch process that is updating denormalization data based on the value in a group.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: USED_IN_TERR_FILTERING_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the path is part of territory filtering
